caption: The drawing features a grayscale, geometric depiction of a building with a simple triangular roof. The upper section displays a textured surface with a single centered window framed by a slight ledge above it. The middle section is composed of a brick or stone texture, while the lower section displays three large, evenly spaced arched doorways or openings. Below the building, there are two horizontal banner shapes, the upper one containing the text "1797" and the lower one containing the text "mision san juan bautista." The background is plain and unadorned, and the entire composition uses shades of black and gray on an off-white or beige paper.
